protocol.tolerant_accuracy: Predicted phase is accepted when the same ground-truth phase occurs within +/-3 seconds in the same contiguous sequence.
protocol.tolerant_phase_f1: For each phase, precision accepts predicted frames near a true frame of that phase; recall accepts true frames near a predicted frame of that phase. F1 is their harmonic mean.
protocol.transition_matching: Same from-phase and to-phase event, nearest unused prediction within +/-3 seconds.
